statements.proposition: This change adds comprehensive test coverage in the file dispatch_workflow_test.go (covering config parsing, job generation, MCP config generation and prompt section generation).
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: The file part is true: pkg/workflow/dispatch_workflow_test.go is a new file (+229) in the PR. But 'comprehensive' is subjective, and the span introduces a list of four areas; the new file only has tests for config parsing (TestParseDispatchWorkflowConfig), job generation (TestBuildDispatchWorkflowJob) and a HasSafeOutputsEnabled check; no tests mentioning MCP or prompt generation appear in that file (other test files could cover them but none are in the change list). Whether the claim is read as 'a test file was added' (TRUE) or as the full listed coverage (partly FALSE) is ambiguous, so not labelled.
